correctness.rationale: The no-C4 hypothesis guarantees each face with at least two vertices belongs to a unique neighborhood simplex. Pair sigma with sigma+chosen root in decreasing size; every pair is elementary, and all higher cofaces were already removed. Root-star union T_X is the residue. The chosen incident edges {y r_y} form a forest since Y vertices have degree one in that selected subgraph, and contracting them sends each remaining edge yx to {r_y,x}; uniqueness prevents parallel duplicated edges. Thus T_X=G/F_Y and K_X collapses to a graph homotopy equivalent to G. Ditto on Y, including leaves and K2. This verifies the graph-minor identification beyond the finite 1501-graph sanity check.
